usage: patchtrace [-h]
                  {rank,flags,correlate,cache,acquire,series,secondary,intelligence,unified,intel-tools,backend,build-env,compare,corrections,diaphora,doctor,export,fabric,graph,inspect,kb,kev,panels,pilot,profile,project,review,rules,runtime,search,strings}
                  ...

PatchTrace headless enrichment commands. Launch without arguments to open the
desktop.

positional arguments:
  {rank,flags,correlate,cache,acquire,series,secondary,intelligence,unified,intel-tools,backend,build-env,compare,corrections,diaphora,doctor,export,fabric,graph,inspect,kb,kev,panels,pilot,profile,project,review,rules,runtime,search,strings}
    rank                rank changed functions by attention/1 change signals
    flags               list WIL feature-flag transitions
    correlate           rerank with CVE context (base ranking unchanged)
    cache               inspect or maintain the global derived/raw cache
    acquire             download two builds from the Microsoft symbol server
                        (SPEC-08)
    series              N-way build series over adjacent pair projects
                        (SPEC-09)
    secondary           second-opinion match sets: BinDiff import, rz-diff
                        (SPEC-10/11)
    intelligence        advisory (CSAF) intelligence: import, fetch, explain
    unified             unified match analysis (experimental, derived,
                        ordinal); the Ghidriff result stays primary
    intel-tools         capa / FLOSS / Detect It Easy evidence (SPEC-29;
                        static, no execution)
    backend             bundled analysis runtime: status, verify, selftest,
                        diagnose
    build-env           build environment of the older and newer file (reads
                        only)
    compare             run the primary Ghidriff analysis for one project pair
                        (static only)
    corrections         manual match corrections: list, export, import, undo
    diaphora            import an existing Diaphora result as optional
                        evidence
    doctor              health report: version, dependencies, verbs, bundle,
                        runtime candidates
    export              export a project as a report (json, md, html; report/1
                        or 2)
    fabric              read the anchor fabric: list, show, resolve or stats
                        (read-only)
    graph               call-graph explorer over stored Ghidriff call lists
                        (read-only)
    inspect             version, manifest and signature facts of both files
                        (static; no execution)
    kb                  KB / CVE advisory correlation (offline; coverage
                        always stated)
    kev                 CISA KEV catalog: status, plan, fetch, import, lookup
    panels              list or check the GUI panel manifest
    pilot               rank changed functions against an advisory: leads,
                        why, review
    profile             analysis profiles: list, show, validate, save, delete
    project             create, inspect, import into, back up and re-orient a
                        project
    review              set the review state of a match or finding, add an
                        analyst note
    rules               detection rules: probe, propose, show, decide, test,
                        export, history
    runtime             inspect or install a local offline runtime archive
    search              search a project's saved names, strings, APIs, code,
                        notes (offline)
    strings             string changes between the two builds (static; never
                        executes them)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
